FEES AND CHARGES

- Residential Property Tax Rates: Calculated as a percentage of Annual Value based on colony categories (A & B: 12%, C to E: 11%, F to H: 7%) (Schedule FY 2025-26 Page 35).

- Transfer Duty (Mutation) Fee: Surcharge on stamp duty. Over Rs. 25 lakhs: 3% for females/third gender, 4% for males/others. Up to Rs. 25 lakhs: 2% for females/third gender, 3% for males/others (Schedule FY 2025-26 Page 42 Clause D).

STATUTORY TIMELINES

- Notice of Property Transfer (Mutation): Must be given within 3 months after execution/registration of instrument of transfer, or within 6 months from date of devolution of title in case of death (DMC Act Sec 128(1) & (2)).

- Failure to give Notice: Transferor continues to be liable for payment of all property taxes until notice is given or recorded in books (DMC Act Sec 128(4)).

- Tax Appeal Timeline: Appeal must be brought within 30 days next after the date of authentication of the assessment list under Section 124 or amendment under Section 126 (DMC Act Sec 170(a)).

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS FOR MUTATION (e-Change of Name)

- Notarized Affidavit on Rs. 10/- stamp paper (Unified Policy Pages 1-2).

- Notarized Indemnity Bond on Rs. 100/- stamp paper (Unified Policy Pages 1-2).

- Death Certificate of previous owner (if applicable) (Unified Policy Pages 1-2).

- Receipts of up-to-date property tax payments (Unified Policy Pages 1-2).

- Complete chain of ownership documents (Unified Policy Pages 1-2).

- Special Case Documents: Surviving Member Certificate (SMC), Registered/Un-registered Will, Succession Certificate / Letter of Administration, or NOC from legal heirs (Unified Policy Page 2 Clause B(ii)).

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS FOR SELF-ASSESSMENT (SUNIYO Scheme)

- 15-digit Unique Property Identification Code (UPIC) (FAQ SUNIYO Scheme Q5).

- Previous tax receipts or relevant proof uploaded online (FAQ SUNIYO Scheme Q5(vi)).

REBATES AND EXEMPTIONS

- Lump-sum Timely Payment Rebate: 10% rebate if tax is paid in lump-sum during the first quarter (on or before June 30th) under Section 123B(3) (Schedule FY 2025-26 Rebate 1).

- Senior Citizen / Women / Ex-Servicemen / Differently Abled Rebate: 30% rebate on covered space up to 100 sq. mtrs on self-occupied residential property under Section 114B (Schedule FY 2025-26 Rebate 2).

- Online Filing Incentive: Additional 2% rebate on tax payable, capped at max tax Rs. 10,000/- and max rebate Rs. 200/- (Schedule FY 2025-26 Rebate 3).

- Exemptions under Section 115(1): Vacant lands for agricultural use, village abadi residential occupied by original owner up to 100 sq. mtrs, public worship, public charity/medical/education free of charge, registered burial/cremation grounds, notified heritage premises, war widows/gallantry award winners (Schedule FY 2025-26 Exemptions i-ix).

OFFICER DESIGNATIONS

- Commissioner (DMC Act Sec 124, 128).

- Assessing Officer concerned (FAQ SUNIYO Scheme Q10).

- Circle Officer of the Zone (Unified Policy Page 1 Clause 4(1)(b)).

- District Judge of Delhi (Appellate Authority under DMC Act Sec 169).

VARIATION RULES

- Rates vary strictly by Colony Category (A-H) and property usage (residential vs commercial/industrial) (Schedule FY 2025-26 Page 35).

REFERENCE NUMBER FORMAT

- 15-digit alphanumeric Unique Property Identification Code (UPIC) (FAQ SUNIYO Scheme Q5).
